items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer and Peter Vacher thanking him. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Peter was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 18, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We are in Clearwater Beach. My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m really looking forward to talking to writer Peter Vacher.
